A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new model that enables to perform efficient online exploration and exploitation, and that it outperforms other models both in terms of online and offline performance.
we show the importance of using uncertainty in online recommender systems.
DDN is a powerful tool for building robust online recommendation systems, and that the use of probability densities for CTR is beneficial for both exploration and exploitation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
by modeling the uncertainty of the data, we can achieve better exploration and exploitation in the context of online recommendation.
by learning to predict the probability density of a CTR, one can improve the performance of an online recommendation system by a large margin.
